name: freshframe
description: Fresh Frame — website. Static React site deployed to GitHub Pages.
comment: server/ is NOT part of the Pages deploy — the contact form posts to Web3Forms. The *:server scripts exist only for the Render/Railway escape hatch described at the top of server/index.js.
